premise: A comet glides over; Astronomer watches it through the telescope and makes a wish — and far out, the probe turns to go and meet it.
inspiration: Wishing on a falling star (folk custom), turned: the wish is to go and see, and it is already on its way.
lesson: Wanting to know more is a wish worth making.
learning: A comet is a ball of ice and dust; its glowing tail always points away from the Sun.

en-US.title: The Comet Wish
en-US.text: {canvas:comet 16s} [gasps] A comet! A ball of ice and dust, gliding across the black sky with a long, glowing tail. {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face surprised} Astronomer raised her binoculars and {astronomer:live} pointed. {telescope:enter} High above, the space telescope {telescope:live hold} turned its golden mirror toward it. Look at the tail, she said. It always points away from the Sun, like hair in a breeze of sunlight. {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face happy} Make a wish! said Astronaut. {astronomer:face happy} Astronomer closed her eyes. [whispers] I wish I could see it up close. And far out in the dark, the {probe:enter} probe turned slowly on its {probe:live} way — toward the comet. {astronomer:face surprised} [excited] Its mission was to go and meet it! {astronomer:face happy} {all:sparkle} Some wishes are already on their way.

es-ES.title: El deseo del cometa
es-ES.text: {canvas:comet 16s} [gasps] ¡Un cometa! Una bola de hielo y polvo que cruzaba el cielo negro con una cola larga y brillante. {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face surprised} Astrónoma levantó los prismáticos y {astronomer:live} señaló. {telescope:enter} Allá arriba, el telescopio espacial {telescope:live hold} giró su espejo dorado hacia él. Mirad la cola, dijo. Siempre apunta al lado contrario del Sol, como un pelo al viento, pero de luz. {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face happy} ¡Pide un deseo! dijo Astronauta. {astronomer:face happy} Astrónoma cerró los ojos. [whispers] Ojalá pudiera verlo de cerca. Y allá lejos, en la oscuridad, la {probe:enter} sonda giró despacio en su {probe:live} camino… hacia el cometa. {astronomer:face surprised} [excited] ¡Su misión era ir a su encuentro! {astronomer:face happy} {all:sparkle} Hay deseos que ya van de camino.
